qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sainsbury's is the #2 UK supermarket chain with strong store estate density and Nectar loyalty data. However, it lacks genuine pricing power, operating as a price-follower to market leader Tesco while being squeezed by hard discounters (Aldi, Lidl). It is forced to match Aldi on hundreds of essential grocery lines ('Aldi Price Match'), capping gross margins. Multi-year underlying pre-tax ROCE sits at 7.6-9.0% (GAAP ROIC ~5-7%), well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 5-7% vs 12% hurdle, REJECT). UK grocery runner-up forced into margin-dilutive Aldi Price Match schemes; retail operating margins stagnant at ~3.0-3.2% and multi-year ROCE of 7.6-9.0% fails the 12% capital efficiency bar.
qualitative.evidence: Underlying ROCE reported between 7.6% and 9.0% (after-tax GAAP ROIC ~5-7%). Retail operating margins remain razor-thin at ~3.0-3.2%. Net debt (including IFRS 16 lease liabilities) is heavy at £5.8B-£6.4B. High price elasticity and promotional matching in the UK food retail sector prevent superior economic returns.
